item.title: Willis looks ahead to return to league action this weekend
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis is feeling optimistic ahead of the Saddlers’ West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One clash against AFC Telford United on Sunday afternoon. The Black Country outfit will host the Bucks at Dales Lane at 2pm, with Willis’ side looking to restart their title charge after two successive Birmingham FA Women’s Challenge Vase games. item.description: Walsall Women striker Molly Cook is eagerly anticipating the Saddlers’ West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One clash with AFC Telford United at Dales Lane on Sunday afternoon. item.title: Match Report: Walsall Women 3-1 AFC Telford United
item.description: Walsall Women ran out 3-1 winners against AFC Telford United Ladies in a relatively comfortable performance at Dales Lane on Sunday afternoon. Mia Fellows’ first half brace put the Saddlers two in front, until Abi Beady struck soon after the restart. However, Phoebe Smith’s late header wrapped up the win as they returned to winning ways in the West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One.
